__note: Canonical English message catalog. To add a language: copy this file to <lang>.json, translate values, and add the code to SUPPORTED in assets/js/i18n.js.

notes.intro1Html: This website allows a patient to provide a health summary and summary of care needs to the healthcare system using the International Patient Summary Standard
notes.intro2: This is not a medical history and is not intended to be complete enough to enable disability/impairment related care (or any other kind of care) by itself
notes.intro3: This is not a beautifully crafted user interface; it's a sample interface intended to help people discuss/describe the requirements for these kind of statements.
notes.intro4: The form is processed locally in your browser; no information is shared with any other system or server, but in general, this form is intended for test data, not real protected health PHI.
notes.ipsToggleLabel: I'm an IPS nerd, show me IPS mappings.
